narrative:
Vinton County has 8,052 registered voters, with 15.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 48.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 18.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.6% of registrants.
